questions.question: Using AD/AS, analyse the effect of a rise in oil prices on price level and real output

points.text: Oil price rise -> production costs ↑ -> SRAS shifts left. Result: price level rises (cost-push inflation), real output falls (stagflation). If central bank accommodates (AD↑), output restored but inflation higher. If not, recession
